additional_source_collectors.bls_laus_2025: separate keyed collector; preparation accepts explicit input paths and verifies collection, CSV, missingness, and raw batch hashes

election_contests.jsonl.unspecified_mode: UNSPECIFIED is quarantined and preserves raw blank mode until publisher semantics are verified

election_candidates.jsonl.values: source_value_status represents source parsing; aggregation_quarantine_reasons are independent; source_mode_raw preserves the original mode field, including blank cells

election_party_results.jsonl.share: selected-party candidatevotes / one consistent contest totalvotes for validated TOTAL contests; absent party is zero only when validated

boundary_features.jsonl.geometry: GeoJSON geometry retained; feature IDs/hash from pinned Census source

irs_agi.per_resident_formula: A00100 thousand USD * 1000 / matching same-geography 2023 PEP total population

cancer.national_rate: uses verified native national 2023 PEP total denominator

bls_period_mapping.monthly: BLS M01-M12 map to period_kind=monthly and period_month 1..12; source_period_code is YYYY-Mnn
bls_period_mapping.annual: BLS M13 maps to period_kind=annual and period_month NULL; source_period_code is YYYY-M13
bls_period_mapping.source_gap_policy: M10 and series-not-returned records remain explicit missing observations; never substitute zero
bls_period_mapping.nation_rate: not emitted because the input contains no national LAUS series

only_admitted_rows_are_application_consu: join usa_atlas.ingest_run.status='pass' and usa_atlas.reader_batch.candidate_status='admitted'; local loader batches are candidate_status='local_review'

native_national_pep.age_groups: age_13_plus and under_18 independently recalculated from native national single-age rows and matched exactly to prepared values
native_national_pep.national_IRS_and_cancer: 2023 national per-resident income and cancer crude rate use verified native total PEP denominator; national cancer numerator=1941540
